name: World History
summary: Ancient civilizations, Renaissance, French Revolution, Industrial Revolution, World Wars, and Cold War.
concept: Covers pivotal global historical epochs: Mesopotamian, Egyptian, and Greco-Roman civilizations; the European Renaissance and Scientific Revolution; the French Revolution (1789, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity); World War I (1914-1918, Treaty of Versailles); Russian Revolution (1917, Bolsheviks); World War II (1939-1945, Pearl Harbor, Hiroshima & Nagasaki); and the Cold War & Fall of the Berlin Wall (1989).

subtopics.name: Revolutions & Global Conflicts
subtopics.summary: French Revolution, World War I, World War II, Cold War.

facts.title: French Revolution & Human Rights (1789)
facts.content: Began with the storming of the Bastille on 14 July 1789, publishing the 'Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen' and popularizing 'Liberty, Equality, Fraternity'.

facts.title: Treaty of Versailles (1919)
facts.content: Peace treaty signed on 28 June 1919 ending World War I between Germany and the Allied Powers, which also established the League of Nations.

mcqs.q: Which colossal neoclassical sculpture was gifted by the people of France to the United States in 1886 to commemorate friendship and liberty?
mcqs.questionText: Which colossal neoclassical sculpture was gifted by the people of France to the United States in 1886 to commemorate friendship and liberty?
mcqs.qHi: 1886 में फ्रांस की जनता ने संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका को स्वतंत्रता और मैत्री के प्रतीक के रूप में कौन सी विशाल प्रतिमा भेंट की थी?
mcqs.questionTextHi: 1886 में फ्रांस की जनता ने संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका को स्वतंत्रता और मैत्री के प्रतीक के रूप में कौन सी विशाल प्रतिमा भेंट की थी?
mcqs.exp: The Statue of Liberty (Liberty Enlightening the World) was sculpted by Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi with internal framework by Gustave Eiffel and dedicated on Liberty Island in New York Harbor in 1886.
mcqs.explanation: The Statue of Liberty (Liberty Enlightening the World) was sculpted by Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi with internal framework by Gustave Eiffel and dedicated on Liberty Island in New York Harbor in 1886.
mcqs.expHi: स्टैच्यू ऑफ लिबर्टी की डिजाइन मूर्तिकार फ्रेडरिक ऑगस्ट बार्थोल्डी ने बनाई थी और इसका आंतरिक ढांचा गुस्ताव एफिल ने तैयार किया था। इसे 1886 में फ्रांस ने अमेरिका को उपहार स्वरूप दिया था।
mcqs.explanationHi: स्टैच्यू ऑफ लिबर्टी की डिजाइन मूर्तिकार फ्रेडरिक ऑगस्ट बार्थोल्डी ने बनाई थी और इसका आंतरिक ढांचा गुस्ताव एफिल ने तैयार किया था। इसे 1886 में फ्रांस ने अमेरिका को उपहार स्वरूप दिया था।
mcqs.hint: Sculpted by Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi and situated on Liberty Island in New York.

mcqs.q: The ancient rose-red city of 'Petra', half-carved into sandstone cliffs, is located in which modern Middle Eastern country?
mcqs.questionText: The ancient rose-red city of 'Petra', half-carved into sandstone cliffs, is located in which modern Middle Eastern country?
mcqs.qHi: चट्टानों को तराश कर बनाई गई प्राचीन 'पेत्रा' (Petra) नगरी किस आधुनिक मध्य-पूर्वी देश में स्थित है?
